system.description:
Trigger: When you make a Focused Attack.

You can choose one of two options.

  • Phenomenon: You gain a +2 to your Attack Roll if the opponent has not seen this maneuver during this Engagement.
  • Flick of the Wrist: As part of the Stamina expended to use this ability, you can Leap up to 3 Spaces before making an Attack. When you make your attack, your range increases by 2. If you had LoS on a creature before leaping, you can attack it without needing LoS. If you attack a creature that cannot see you, you gain a +2 to your Attack Roll.
